name: settings popover open (lang-select, label.hoverHelp, ui.on on the switch)
settings popover open, hover help OFF (ui.off on the switch)
eval: (() => { const p = document.getElementById('settings-popover'); if (p.hidden) document.getElementById('gear-btn').click(); const t = document.getElementById('tips-toggle'); if (t.getAttribute('aria-pressed') === 'true') t.click(); })()

name: hover help back ON, popover closed
eval: (() => { const t = document.getElementById('tips-toggle'); if (t.getAttribute('aria-pressed') !== 'true') t.click(); const p = document.getElementById('settings-popover'); if (!p.hidden) document.getElementById('gear-btn').click(); })()

name: all parameters at their defaults (the gate's own state pass moved them)
eval: (() => { const P = {"azimuth":0,"elevation":0,"distance":1,"order":0,"yaw":0,"pitch":0,"roll":0,"decoder":0,"orbit":0,"orbitRate":0.1,"inputMode":0}; const st = window.__stubStates; for (const [id, v] of Object.entries(P)) { if (st.sliders.has(id)) { const s = st.sliders.get(id), p = s.properties; const prop = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (v - p.start) / (p.end - p.start))); s.setNormalisedValue(Math.pow(prop, p.skew)); } else if (st.combos.has(id)) st.combos.get(id).setChoiceIndex(v); else if (st.toggles.has(id)) st.toggles.get(id).setValue(!!v); } })()
